City of Encinitas
Youth Commission Agenda
AGENDA
SEPTEMBER 5, 2018 -
04:30 PM
City of Encinitas - Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Ave
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Commission.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS None
5.
COMMISSIONER’S OATH OF OFFICE
5A.
Conducted by Commission Secretary Crystal Roff.
5B.
Introductions
City Council Liaison, Council Member Tasha Boerner Horvath, Parks and Recreation Director, Jennifer Campbell, Recreation Supervisor, Ken Rundle and Management Analyst, Crystal Roff.
6.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES) Each speaker has three (3) minutes to address the Youth Commission. There are no time donations during Oral Communications. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the Clerk. Direction to staff to bring back a future agenda item or provide additional information to answer a question requires consent of at least two Commission Members.
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announce administrative changes to the agenda in compliance with the Brown Act.
8.
APPROVAL OF THE MAY 2, 2018 YOUTH COMMISSION REGULAR MEETING MINUTES
8A.
Approve the May 2, 2018 Youth Commission regular meeting minutes.
Agenda Item 8A. May 2, 2018 Regular Meeting Minutes
9.
ACTION ITEMS
9A.
Youth Commission Chair and Vice-Chair
The Youth Commission by ballot elects the FY2018-19 Chair and Vice Chair to serve a one-year term.
Agenda Item 9A. Election of Chair and Vice-Chair
9B.
FY 2018-19 Youth Commission Work Plan
The Youth Commission will review a list of potential work plan initiatives and begin work on the plan and assignment of Youth Commission representatives (maximum of (3) commissioners per initiative)
Agenda ITem 9B. Commission Work Plan
9C.
FY 2018-19 Youth Commission Meeting Calendar
The Youth Commission adopts the proposed FY 2018-19 Youth Commission meeting calendar.
Agenda Item 9C. Meeting Calendar
10.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
10A.
City Council Liaison report – Council Member Boerner-Horvath
10B.
Department updates – Director Campbell
10C.
2018 Commission Member Resource Handbook - Supervisor Rundle
10D.
2018-19 Cultural Tourism Calendar of events - Supervisor Rundle
10A.
City Council Liaison report – Council Member Boerner-Horvath
10C.
2018 Commission Member Resource Handbook - Supervisor Rundle
11.
COMMISSION MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM Commissioner prepared and presented agenda items.
12.
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS ADDED BY COMMISSION MEMBERS Commissioners may add future agenda items with consensus of two or more Commissioners.
13.
COMMISSION REPORTS Roundtable – All Commissioners
ADJOURNMENT
